readingUncertainties: 13/10 and 23/10 are recorded as days off exactly as printed, even though the previous duty's end time falls on those dates; the roster does not reconcile that overlap itself.

The Fin column has no station label of its own — I read it as local at the arrival station of the last sector, which is what the header's 'estacion indicada' rule implies and what the consistent 30-minute post-arrival debrief across all sixteen flight duties confirms.
